WITH
-- Most frequent role per player
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, cnt,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, role) as rn
        FROM (
            SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as cnt
            FROM player_match
            GROUP BY player_id, role
        ) sub
    ) sub2 WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Total runs scored per player
runs_scored AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bbb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
-- Total balls faced per player
balls_faced AS (
    SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY striker
),
-- Total dismissals per player
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),
-- Matches played per player
matches_played AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as total_matches
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
-- Match runs for batting thresholds
match_runs_bat AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, bbb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bbb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
-- Highest score in a single match
highest_score AS (
    SELECT player_id, MAX(match_runs) as highest_score
    FROM match_runs_bat
    GROUP BY player_id
),
-- Matches with >= 30, 50, 100 runs
run_thresholds AS (
    SELECT player_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 END) as matches_30,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 END) as matches_50,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 END) as matches_100
    FROM match_runs_bat
    GROUP BY player_id
),
-- Total wickets per player
wickets AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wkt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON wkt.match_id = bbb.match_id AND wkt.over_id = bbb.over_id AND wkt.ball_id = bbb.ball_id
    WHERE bbb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler
),
-- Runs conceded and balls bowled per player per match
bowling_per_match AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, bbb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded,
        COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bbb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
),
economy AS (
    SELECT player_id,
        SUM(runs_conceded) as total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(balls_bowled) as total_balls_bowled
    FROM bowling_per_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
-- Wickets per player per match
bowling_stats AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, bbb.match_id,
        COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wkt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON wkt.match_id = bbb.match_id AND wkt.over_id = bbb.over_id AND wkt.ball_id = bbb.ball_id
    WHERE bbb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
),
-- Runs conceded per player per match (separate)
bowling_runs_match AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, bbb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE bbb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
),
-- Best bowling performance
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT bs.player_id, bs.wickets, br.runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bs.player_id ORDER BY bs.wickets DESC, br.runs_conceded ASC) as rn
    FROM bowling_stats bs
    JOIN bowling_runs_match br ON bs.player_id = br.player_id AND bs.match_id = br.match_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.role as most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(rs.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    mp.total_matches,
    COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 
        THEN 1.0 * rs.total_runs / d.total_dismissals 
        ELSE NULL 
    END as batting_average,
    hs.highest_score,
    COALESCE(rt.matches_30, 0) as matches_30,
    COALESCE(rt.matches_50, 0) as matches_50,
    COALESCE(rt.matches_100, 0) as matches_100,
    COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.balls_faced, 0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(1.0 * rs.total_runs / bf.balls_faced * 100, 2) 
        ELSE NULL 
    END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(w.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.total_balls_bowled, 0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(1.0 * e.total_runs_conceded / e.total_balls_bowled * 6, 2) 
        ELSE NULL 
    END as economy_rate,
    CAST(bb.wickets AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(bb.runs_conceded AS VARCHAR) as best_bowling_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_scored rs ON p.player_id = rs.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_played mp ON p.player_id = mp.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals d ON p.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN highest_score hs ON p.player_id = hs.player_id
LEFT JOIN run_thresholds rt ON p.player_id = rt.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON p.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN wickets w ON p.player_id = w.player_id
LEFT JOIN economy e ON p.player_id = e.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bb ON p.player_id = bb.player_id AND bb.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT 10

# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.
